findings_qualitative.value: No ALMA-blank LABOCA fields show evidence of missed luminous SMGs; they likely reflect multiplicity or extended emission

claims.hypothesis: ALMA-identified SMGs have higher q_IR than single-dish selected samples because they are not radio-biased
claims.experiment: Measure q_IR with individual K-corrections for 76 ALMA SMGs
claims.finding: Higher q_IR consistent with removing radio-bias in counterpart identification

evidence.quote: which may reflect the fact that our ALMA-based study is not biased to radio-bright counterparts, as previous samples were
We search for evolution in q IR, but find no compelling evidence for any such evolution

claims.hypothesis: alpha and q_IR evolve with starburst age as in Bressan models
claims.experiment: Segregate SMGs into age groups along model tracks and compare M* and Mdust
claims.result: weak correlations of M* and Mdust with age

evidence.quote: there is tentative evidence of a correlation between progress along the evolutionary track and both M ⋆ and M dust .

why_this_data.value: ALMA gives precise positions so radio counterparts are identified without statistical association

evidence.quote: The ALMA observations allow us to obtain precise positions for a sample of SMGs

limitations_admitted.value: Small number of SMGs per age bin makes correlations weak; upper-limit spectral indices boost L1.4GHz and lower q_IR

evidence.loc: 4.4 Trends in α and q IR in high-redshift ULIRGs
